text: \ Minutes of the Second Meeting of the Compassionate Appointment Committee for considering compassionate appointment applications, for recommending candidates to the post of MTS in DPIIT, held under the Chairmanship of Shri Susheel Kumar Kalra, Director 14.11.2024 at 11 :00 AM . .................... A follow-up meeting of the Departmental Committee consisting of the following ~embers to consider the applications received from the dependents of the deceased efl}.ployees of DPIIT to fill-up 2 vacancies of MTS in DPIIT on compassionate Grounds was held on 14.11.2024 at 11 :00 i6ntinuing the discussions from the first meeting held on 18.10.2024 at 3 :00 PM. The list of participants is as under: I. Shri Susheel Kumar Kalra, Director - Chairman II. Shri Rajeev Kumar Jain, Deputy Secretary - Member III. Shri Hemant Kumar, Deputy Secretary - Member 2. The committee was provided with copies of relevant records/documents viz. 100 point-scale/marking system, all the information/documents submitted by the applicants, Master Circular on Compassionate appointment issued by DoPT, the details of verified service records (i.e. Initial basic pension/ DCR Gratuity/ GPF Balance/ CGEGIS/ Leave Encashment/ Date of Birth/ Date of Death) of deceased government servants are attached at Annexure-A. 3. The Committee held detailed analysis of the documents for consideration for appointment to the post of MTS on compassionate grounds in DPIIT. The committee assigned marks to each of the 44 applications as per the details submitted by the applicants and assessed on the basis of 100 point-scale system issued by DPIIT vide OM no. A-12012/2/2021- Establishment D dated 15.02.2023. The list showing the marks assigned are attached as Annexure-B. 4. Smt. Sunita, (SI. No. 6 in the marksheet) and Smt. Shakuntla ( SI. No. 24 in the marksheet) obtained 60 marks each as per the prescribed marks criteria. As the said two candidates obtained equal marks, the Committee decided to apply Tie- Breaking Factor defined at point no. 13 of the 100-point-scale system of DPIIT which was based on DoPT OM no. A012012/l/2021-Ad.lV(Cadre) dated 07.04.2022. Tie-breaking factor applied for deciding the second suitable is reiterated asiind.er: 13(i) "Available income per dependent i.e. total of first three financial parameters mentioned in Point no. 1,2 and 3 above (Pension-annualized, total terminal benefits and annual income f of earning members), divided by total number of dependents. The result with the lesser available income per dependent will have the higher rank amongst the applicants whose scores had a tie". On the basis of the result arrived by applying the tie-breaking factor as stated above, the Committee observed that Smt. Sunita [W/o Late Shri Manohar Lal] has lesser ~ Jf~ / - -- 1 of 5 -- available income per dependent and secured higher rank in comparison to Smt. Shakuntla..
